notes: Default Grand Army of Bretonnia from the WHR Armies Compendium.
Heroic Bretonnia is an alternative army mode in the source and is retained as reference rather than applied automatically.
Knightly virtues count toward a knight's magic item maximum and are unique within the army.

factionMagicItems.name: Lance of Lot
factionMagicItems.rules: Lance. +1 to hit and +1 Strength on the charge.

factionMagicItems.name: Caliburnus
factionMagicItems.rules: General only. +2 WS, +2 Strength and +2 Attacks.

factionMagicItems.name: Shield of Holiness and Virtue
factionMagicItems.rules: Knightly characters only. Ignore all hits against the bearer in the first combat round during challenges.

factionMagicItems.name: Antlers of the Great Hunt
factionMagicItems.rules: Knightly characters only. Bearer and unit may re-roll failed pursuit rolls.

factionMagicItems.name: The Tress of Isoulde
factionMagicItems.rules: One use only. Knightly characters only. Bearer wounds automatically; no armour saves.

factionMagicItems.name: Bufo's Hex Scroll
factionMagicItems.rules: One use only. Dispels a spell even with Total Power; caster is turned into a frog (Slann Mage Priests immune).

factionMagicItems.name: Errantry Banner
factionMagicItems.rules: Chevaliers Errant only. No armour save from charge hits (not mounts).

factionMagicItems.name: Questing Banner
factionMagicItems.rules: Chevaliers en Quête only. Immune to psychology.

factionMagicItems.name: Banner of the Grail
factionMagicItems.rules: Chevaliers D'Honneur only. Automatically pass first failed Leadership test, including break tests.

factionMagicItems.name: Virtue of Bravery
factionMagicItems.rules: Knight and regiment are immune to fear.

factionMagicItems.name: Virtue of the Joust
factionMagicItems.rules: When charging with a lance, the knight hits automatically.

factionMagicItems.name: Virtue of Knightly Temper
factionMagicItems.rules: Double the Attacks on the knight's profile on the charge.

factionMagicItems.name: Virtue of Trial by Combat
factionMagicItems.rules: Must issue/accept challenges; re-roll hit and wound; enemy re-rolls successful armour and unmodified saves.

factionMagicItems.name: Virtue of Knightly Ardour
factionMagicItems.rules: Unit may counter-charge 1D6 inches under the listed conditions.

factionMagicItems.name: Virtue of the Impetuous Knight
factionMagicItems.rules: Knight and unit gain +1D6 inches on charge moves.

faction.name: The Grand Army of Bretonnia
armyWideRules: Bretonnian Warhorses do not suffer the -1 Movement penalty for barding.
A Knight's Army: the general must be a knightly character, not a wizard, and the army must include at least one Chevalier regiment.
Knightly Disdain: knightly regiments and characters ignore panic caused by non-knightly troops; knightly characters never join Peasant regiments.

heroicBretonnia.name: Heroic Bretonnia (alternative army)
rules: Alternative 5th-edition-style army mode from the WHR source.
May not include Peasants or war machines.
Uses the Lady's Blessing, Lance Formation and Arrowhead Formation rules.

specialCharacters.name: The Hermit Knight
rules: Virtue of Bravery: the knight and his regiment are immune to fear.
May not join knight regiments; may join commoners.

specialCharacters.name: Louen Leoncoeur, The Lionhearted
rules: Must always be the general.
Virtue of the Lionheart: +1D3 Strength each melee phase.
Crown of Bretonnia; Lion Lance; Tabard of Kings; Armour of Brilliance.

specialCharacters.name: The Green Knight
rules: Always acts alone; never joins regiments.
Causes fear; immune to psychology; natural dispel 2+; regenerate 2+.
Dolorous Blade: one no-save attack causing 1D6 wounds, or 1D6 normal attacks.

specialCharacters.name: Baron Odo d'Outremer and Suliman le Saracen
rules: Odo: Morning Star of Fracasse; wounded models lose their magic weapon.
Odo and Suliman always fight together and may join knight regiments.

specialCharacters.name: Tancred, Duc de Quenelles
rules: Blade of Couronne; Blessed Draught; Grail Shield.
Virtue of Purity: natural dispel 4+.

specialCharacters.name: The Knight of the Perilous Lance
rules: Enemies suffer -1 to hit him on the turn he charges.
May re-roll armour saves in melee.
Virtue of the Joust: automatically hits when charging with a lance.

specialCharacters.name: Reynard le Chasseur
rules: Boar spear: wounded enemies lose 1D6 Attacks in the first combat round.
War hawk: melee attacks against Reynard are -1 to hit.
May lead Chasseurs de la Mort.

specialCharacters.name: Bohemond Beastslayer, Duke of Bastonne
rules: Beast Mace of Bastonne: +2 Strength; each wound causes 1D3 wounds.
Bohemond's Shield protects against magic weapon hits.
Virtue of the Impetuous Knight: +1D6 inches on charge moves.

specialCharacters.name: Roland le Marechal
rules: Roland's Warhorn: bound spell; drives off enemy flyers within 12 inches.

specialCharacters.name: Armand d'Aquitaine
rules: Battle Standard Bearer.
Banner of the Lady of the Lake: enemies in melee cannot claim rank bonus.
Virtue of Knightly Ardour: unit may counter-charge under the listed conditions.

specialCharacters.name: Bertrand the Brigand and the Bowmen of Bergerac
rules: 75 points includes Bertrand, Hugo, Gui and two Bowmen of Bergerac.
Extra Bowmen cost 9 points each.
All models count towards Regiments rather than Characters.
Bertrand's Black Arrow: always hits and wounds, no armour save, one use only.

specialCharacters.name: Tristan le Troubadour and Jules le Jongleur

additionalProfiles.label: Jules le Jongleur
notes: Companion; attacks against Jules are -2 to hit

rules: Tristan hates enemy troops with missile weapons, including war machine crew.
Each Bretonnia turn Tristan may sing: +1 combat resolution, natural dispel 3+, or Leadership 10 for his regiment.
Enemies attacking Tristan while Jules is in base contact must pass Leadership or lose one Attack.

specialCharacters.name: Jasperre le Bau, Dragonslayer
rules: Immune to psychology.
Dragonhelm: immune to terror, fire and breath attacks.
Virtuous Lance: causes 1D6 wounds to large targets.
Claw of Malgrimace: Monsters and Daemons in base contact lose half their attacks, rounding up.

specialCharacters.name: Morgiana le Fay, The Fay Enchantress
rules: Wizard Lord with unique spells.
Unmarried; makes Chevaliers Errant she joins unbreakable while alive.
May grant favours to knightly characters before battle.
Carries the Chalice of Potions, Morgiana's Mirror, Power Familiar and Girdle of Gold (4+ ward).

specialCharacters.name: Repanse du Lyonesse
rules: Knightly Lord and Battle Standard Bearer; must always carry the battle standard and may be the general.
Causes fear and is immune to the effects of spells.
Sword of Lyonesse: ignores minus-to-hit modifiers and allows no armour or unmodified save.
Fleur de Lys Banner: discard one random opponent magic card each magic phase.
